items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Even Andy Williams -- they're singers. But they can afford to go along with big bands

ctx.x: : Well, anyway, his orchestrations are beautiful.
And you take a guy like Sinatra, he don't have anything else. Even Andy Williams -- they're singers. But they can afford to go along with big bands,
beautiful instrumental sound, and they don't have more than one, two arrangers. But not everybody can work for those guys.
